findings.title: Missing `key` prop on GrafanaRuleListItem in rule list map
findings.body: `GrafanaRuleLoader` was replaced with `GrafanaRuleListItem`, but the `key={key}` prop was dropped. The other branches in this `rules.map` still pass a key. React will warn about missing keys. Worse, items are reconciled by index while new pages are concatenated, so per-item state such as open menus, the silence drawer, and the delete modal can attach to the wrong rule.

findings.title: Delete and Pause never shown in list view despite prom-based permission checks
findings.body: `canDelete` and `canPause` now OR in the promRule-based abilities. However, the Delete item still requires `rulerRule` to be present (line 165), and the Pause item requires `rulerRuleType.grafana.rule(rulerRule)` (line 123). The list view no longer passes `rulerRule`, so users with full permissions lose the Delete and Pause actions there. The new GrafanaGroupLoader test asserts exactly 4 menu items, which locks this regression in.

findings.title: Silence menu item shown but does nothing when only promRule is provided
findings.body: In the list view, AlertRuleMenu shows 'Silence notifications' based on the promRule abilities. Clicking it only sets `showSilenceDrawer`. The drawer renders only when `rulerRuleType.grafana.alertingRule(rule)` is true, and `rule` (the ruler rule) is now undefined in the list view. The button is therefore a silent no-op for users.

findings.title: Federated rule group detection removed from legacy ability hook
findings.body: `useAllAlertRuleAbilities(CombinedRule)` previously computed `isFederated = isFederatedRuleGroup(rule.group)`. It now delegates to `useAllRulerRuleAbilities`, which hardcodes `isFederated = false`. Federated Mimir rule groups in the existing (V1) list and detail views are no longer treated as immutable. Update, Delete and Pause become supported for them.

findings.title: Export/Pause/Restore restricted to alerting rules for Grafana prom rules
findings.body: The ruler-based hook gates ModifyExport, Pause, Restore and DeletePermanently on `isGrafanaManagedAlertRule`, which is true for any Grafana rule, including recording rules. The new prom-based hook uses `prometheusRuleType.grafana.alertingRule(rule)` instead. As a result, Grafana-managed recording rules can no longer be exported or paused from the list view. The variable name suggests 'Grafana-managed' was intended.

findings.title: Rule view link lost `returnTo` parameter
findings.body: The removed implementation built the href with `createRelativeUrl(`/alerting/grafana/${uid}/view`, { returnTo })`. The new component drops `returnTo`, so navigating back from the rule detail page no longer returns users to their filtered or scrolled list position.
